additional_sources.title: Perenco UK Southern North Sea: Annual Public Statement of Environmental Performance 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted statement explicitly reports 2024 PUK SNS overall installation diesel/gas combustion CO2e, the UK ETS-verifiable subset, and exact Cleeton/Leman 27B/Trent installation values. Aggregate and nested component rows are protected against double counting and remain offshore/non-cadastral.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Pollution Inventory 2024 dataset
additional_sources.guard: Official Environment Agency dataset covers annual mass releases from large regulated industrial sites in England, including whole-permit point and fugitive releases. The 2024 ZIP resource is authoritative but binary fetch failed in the current client; no facility quantity is invented without a readable row.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Annual CO2 emissions from regulated installation operators
additional_sources.guard: Official Environment Agency dataset provides annual CO2e emissions from regulated installation operators in England holding greenhouse-gas permits. The linked XLSX is high-value facility evidence; current binary fetch failed, so no row is fabricated or inferred.

additional_sources.title: DESNZ: Functioning of the UK carbon market, 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official UK ETS report gives visually verified 2024 scheme and sector totals. These are scheme-level context only, not installation or cadastral parcel emissions.

additional_sources.title: Drax Group plc ESG Performance Report 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official Drax ESG table visually verifies 2024 Generation and Group Scope 1/2 carbon metrics plus separately reported biogenic CO2. Group/Generation/context values cannot be silently attributed to Drax Power Station or an England parcel; aggregate/component rows are protected against double counting.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Explicit scope, gas, quantity, unit, period and provenance are required. Dataset surfaces without readable rows remain source-only. Group/offshore values cannot become England cadastral parcels.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit/address/facility data supports identity and onshore binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Scheme totals and context support QA but cannot become facility or parcel values.

web_research_basis: Fresh official/public internet research on 2026-07-27. PUK SNS explicit 2024 values were read from the official OPRED PDF. UK carbon-market and Drax 2024 tables were visually screenshot-verified. Environment Agency 2024 Pollution Inventory and annual regulated-installation CO2 dataset surfaces were verified on data.gov.uk; linked binary resources failed in the current client and were not repeatedly retried. No OCR, graph-axis interpolation, facility attribution or parcel inference was used.
